scope: Local implementation of sub-slice S2-2 of docs/QR_4_QUALIFIED_SELECTION_CONTRACT.md (RC-S21 to RC-S27, RC-S29): window freezes, evaluation starts, outcomes and replay events join the uninstalled QR-4 selection install; the first evaluation start rechecks the window under the exposure register lock (RO-12) and binds exactly one QR4_SELECTION register row in the same transaction; later starts and the outcome write read the register lock-first (readExposuresLocked); nothing after the registration may be written in the registration transaction. Tie tolerances stay unset (OD-S3). Nothing is installed on staging and no route or job calls the writers.
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the S2 design and root decided RC-S21 to RC-S27. A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote S2-2; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed rounds 1 and 2 and a second-opinion reviewer (Fable 5.1) reviewed round 1, and root confirmed every Fable finding before acting on it; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each of three rounds. Root ruled on every finding. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module of the three slices of this wave (found with git grep): 54 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (804 tests, 0 fail; 3 skipped by environment gates in files this wave did not change: one non-loopback address check and two TEMP-privilege suites), the full unit suite (2150 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test. Two later test-only assertions (one QR-3 reader case and one S3b import-scanner case) were checked by an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) with their target mutations, both killed. Root then added the four S2-2 tables to the PostgreSQL grant test list and reran that file. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: quant-selection 16 of 16, quant-selection-register 26 of 26 and quant-selection-recheck 23 of 23 pass with 0 skipped; the exposure register adapter tests pass in the unit suite; the PostgreSQL grant test passes with the eight QR-4 tables listed.

mutations.round1: 14 killed, 3 survived: the commit-check zero-row clauses for starts, outcomes and replays, which the same-transaction refusal of round 2 makes unreachable; they stay as a backstop.
mutations.round2: 6 of 7 killed; the survivor sits behind the freeze check and is unreachable.
mutations.round3: 3 of 3 killed (rollback helper drop, replay evaluation-list refusal, the later-event refusal in the registration transaction).

limits: The commit-check zero-row clauses for starts, outcomes and replays are not reachable by any write the guards allow; they are a backstop only.
The tie tolerances (OD-S3) are unset; outcomes in the tests use an injected test registry.
QR-4 S3 must tell research runs and evaluation runs apart in readSearchedWindows.
No install was run on any environment.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted S2-2 as local engineering evidence for the QR-4 row (F10-03). Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
